readings: The flip-flop powers up with an unknown/undefined value (e.g., X in simulation), so 'out' is X until a known pattern is clocked in; since feedback is X XOR in = X, out may remain X indefinitely.
The flip-flop powers up with a defined value, typically 0 in synthesis or 1 depending on technology, leading to deterministic but implementation-dependent toggling behavior from the first clock edge.
